$comment: Style-Bert-VITS2 / AivisSpeech voices (tts_helpers::sbv2, P6-G). The engine runs in Sigil's process on its own ONNX Runtime (no sbv2 server pack: P6-G ported sbv2_core instead, see tts_helpers/sbv2.rs), so the only downloads are these two published assets; the voices themselves are the user's .aivmx files (imported, never downloaded by Sigil).

tts/sbv2-bert-ja (BERT_MODEL_ID): ku-nlp/deberta-v2-large-japanese-char-wwm as the half-precision ONNX export AivisSpeech uses (tsukumijima/deberta-v2-large-japanese-char-wwm-onnx: input_ids, attention_mask, token_type_ids -> the third-to-last hidden state) and its character tokenizer. A full-precision model.onnx placed in the same folder by hand also works.

text/jpreprocess-naist-jdic (DICTIONARY_ID): OpenJTalk's NAIST-JDIC built for jpreprocess 0.15 (a dictionary must come from the same jpreprocess release as the crate: update it together with Cargo.toml's jpreprocess). The Japanese readings of the text-readings plugin (P6-L) can use the same entry.
Update: pin with node scripts/models/pin-catalog.mjs --fragment src-tauri/model-catalog/runtime-sbv2.json --write, and keep BERT_MODEL_ID / DICTIONARY_ID in tts_helpers/sbv2.rs in step.

entries.title: Japanese BERT for Style-Bert-VITS2 voices
entries.description: The language model Style-Bert-VITS2 and AivisSpeech voices read Japanese text with (DeBERTa-v2 large, half precision, as AivisSpeech uses it). About 650 MB download.

entries.title: Japanese dictionary (NAIST-JDIC for jpreprocess)
entries.description: OpenJTalk's Japanese dictionary: how kanji, accents and numbers are read for Japanese voices. About 29 MB download.
